title: Expanding the spectrum of TBX5 mutations in Holt-Oram syndrome: detection of two intragenic deletions by quantitative real time PCR, and report of eight novel point mutations.

reviewer.method: Personally read the entire available indexed abstract and all4 assigned selected/alternate packets, including every allele and phenotype item. Reviewed inherited legal public-route receipts and verified stored bytes/hashes. Authored abstract-limited comparisons and explicit maintext/component gaps; no fulltext reading or completed packet adjudication claimed.

audit.exposure_note: Mandatory HANDOFF.md reading exposed historical HG002/FGFR2 public-control case-specific rank and aggregate results. No target-case outcome files, current assigned-cohort ranks, or evaluator outputs were consulted. Not blinded. Inherited material is attributed to its original reviewer; new reading claims are limited to this method.
